"''Well, this ain't a quick job, it's a war!|Rio Durant and Tobias Beckett during a firefight with the Mimbanese|}} The '''battle on Mimban''',''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story: Meet the Crew]]'' also known as the '''battle at Mimban''', was one of the bloodiest battles{{BustCollectionCite|51|Character}} of the [[Imperial Military]]'s [[Mimban Campaign]]. The engagement was also infiltrated by [[Beckett's gang]] in order to steal an [[Y-45 armored transport hauler]] for their planned [[heist on Vandor]]. One member of the gang, [[Korso]], was [[Death|killed]]. Charging back to [[Imperial Forward Field Operations|Camp Forward]] under "[[Captain]]" [[Tobias Beckett]]'s "command," the [[Corporal]] [[Han Solo]] took notice of the fact that the gang were not [[Imperial Army trooper]]s. In his ensuing '''escape from Mimban''', Solo teamed up with the im[[prison]]ed [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]] to unite with the gang and escape the active warzone. Solo hoped to use his earnings from the heist with the gang to return to his [[homeworld]] [[Corellia]] and reunite with his lover [[Qi'ra]], while Chewbacca hoped to find Wookiees from his tribe or family. ==Aftermath== After escaping Mimban, Solo and Chewbacca traveled to the planet [[Vandor]], where Beckett enlisted their services in stealing [[coaxium]] from an Imperial [[20-T Railcrawler conveyex transport|conveyx transport]] in order to pay his debts to [[Dryden Vos]], the [[crime lord]] of the [[Crimson Dawn]]. Due to the interference of [[Enfys Nest]] and her [[Cloud-Riders]], the heist failed and Val and Durant were killed in the process. [[File:Punch-it-chewie-joe-corroney.png|thumb|left|250px|After he left the Empire on Mimban, Solo had set the stage for the rest of his life.]] Solo and Beckett managed to convince Dryden Vos to give them a second chance with the help of the crime lord's lieutenant [[Qi'ra]], an old friend of Solo. After enlisting the services of [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] and his ship the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'', Solo and his companions managed to [[Raid on Kessel|steal]] coaxium from the [[Pyke Syndicate]]'s mines on the planet [[Kessel]]. After making the [[Kessel Run]] in 12 [[parsec]]s, Han and his companions traveled to the planet [[Savareen]] to rendezvous with Dryden Vos. However, Enfys Nest and her Cloud-Riders convinced them not to give the coaxium to Vos. Despite Beckett's betrayal, Han and Qi'ra managed to [[Showdown on Savareen|defeat]] Vos and his [[Hylobon Enforcers]]. Beckett was later killed during a confrontation with Solo. Even though Qi'ra left him, Solo and Chewbacca left together, ultimately becoming [[smuggler]]s{{Film|IV}} and winning the ''Falcon'' from Calrissian. {{Battle-stub}} ==Appearances== {{IncompleteList}} *''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' {{1st}} *''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story: Expanded Edition]]'' {{Ab|Solo: A Star Wars Story: Expanded Edition (audiobook)}} *''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story: A Junior Novel]]'' {{Ab|Solo: A Star Wars Story: A Junior Novel (audiobook)}} *[[Solo: A Star Wars Story Read-Along Storybook and CD|''Solo: A Star Wars Story'' Read-Along Storybook and CD]] *''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story: Meet the Crew]]'' {{1stID|battle on Mimban}} *[[Solo: A Star Wars Story Graphic Novel Adaptation|''Solo: A Star Wars Story'' Graphic Novel Adaptation]] *[[Solo: A Star Wars Story Adaptation 1|''Solo: A Star Wars Story Adaptation'' 1]] ==Sources== {{SourceContents-start|{{BustCollectionCite|51|parent=1}} {{1stID|escape from Mimban}}}} *{{BustCollectionCite|51|Star Wars Universe}} *{{BustCollectionCite|51|Character}} {{SourceContents-end}} *''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' *''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' {{1stID|battle at Mimban}} *{{FalconCite|1|Starship Fact File}} {{Imo}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Mimban, battle on}} [[Category:Battles of the Mimban Campaign]]
